content.title: Selena Gomez Reinvents the Cargo Minidress in an Unexpected Color With a Surprising Peekaboo Detail
content.text: The perfect party dress. Published on April 3, 2026 @ 09:04AM Credit: Getty Selena Gomez celebrated the launch of Rare Beauty's True To Myself Natural Matte Longwear Foundation in West Hollywood on April 2.She wore a reflective bubblegum pink minidress with cargo pockets and an embellished collar for the occasion.The dress included a playful peekaboo detail at the hem. Selena Gomez clearly knows the power of a strong color—because her latest look was all about making a statement thanks to a bold, bright, and playful pop of pink. Attending the launch party for Rare Beauty's True To Myself Natural Matte Longwear Foundation in West Hollywood on April 2, Gomez leaned into a 1960s-coded mod look with a few modern touches. Her reflective bubblegum pink minidress had an uexpected peekaboo hem. Getty Her Prada minidress was the perfect, Barbie-approved shade of bubblegum pink, which seemed to catch the light thanks to its lustrous wool and silk blend. The shift dress featured a boxy silhouette with oversized shoulders and faux cargo-style pockets. Perfect for an evening out, the dress also featured the added detail of white beaded embellishments around the neckline. Gomez added a little extra length to the minidress with a pale blue and white striped bubble skirt, which peeked out below the hemline. She completed the party-ready look with bright white slingback heels and silver hoop earrings. Selena Gomez shows off her new foundation. Selena/Gomez As for her glam, she stuck to the pink theme, with a rosy blush, a pink lip, and even a swipe of pink eyeshadow. She finished things off with an ultra slick bun, with two thin strands framing her face. Gomez also shared her new product on Instagram yesterday ahead of the celebration. "My team and I at @rarebeauty have been working on this 3-in-1 natural matte foundation for years to make getting ready easier," she wrote. "It’s super lightweight, lasts all day, and honestly looks even better the longer you wear it. I love using it with our new Soft Touch Makeup Blending Sponge." Related Stories Though Gomez's latest party look was all about color, last month, she served up a very different look for a very different event. For her husband Benny Blanco's rodeo-themed 38th birthday, she opted for Daisy Duke cutoffs and bedazzled cowboy boots. "happy birthday my love 🥳♥️," she wrote alongside a carousel of photos of the couple at the birthday bash. "I love you with all my heart." Blanco replied in the comments section: "u r the best birffday present i could ever ask for." "Happy birthday cowboy". Selena Gomez/Instagram Look of the day
